description: ODC: the REFUSAL of a set Identifier that collides with the name of another record of the same static entity. The native setter (SetName) would add a suffix in SILENCE (Received -> Received2), like the Studio grid; the kernel now checks AbstractObject.NameClash before writing, as rename already did, and refuses with the name the Studio would use. The clean path is in tests/jobs-odc/static-entity-lifecycle.json.
expectError: set Identifier: 'Received' clashes with an existing name in that scope

ops._why: the name that already exists in the scope: Received.
